ambient_events: The airframe groans somewhere overhead, a long metallic complaint that means nothing.
Light slides across the cabin floor as the world tilts past the row of small round windows.
The bulkhead heaters tick as they cycle, and the cold pressed against the hull stays outside.
description: The main cabin of the Leviathan: a ribbed aluminium tube slung between the flight deck and the hold, fitted out for people rather than pallets. A run of low seats lines one wall under a row of small round windows; webbing straps and grab-rails hang from the frames. This is where you climb aboard and where you ride. The flight deck lies forward to the NORTH; the galley aft to the SOUTH.
name: Main Cabin
